articles.title: Baidu’s Apollo Go and AutoGo launch driverless rides in Abu Dhabi
articles.mainIdea: Baidu’s Apollo Go and AutoGo launch driverless rides in Abu Dhabi
articles.summary: Just Auto: Baidu’s Apollo Go and AutoGo launch driverless rides in Abu Dhabi. The companies have launched a fully autonomous ride-hailing service on Yas Island, where passengers can now book rides without a human driver using the AutoGo app.

articles.title: Is Lyft (LYFT) Pricing Reflect Its DCF Upside After Recent Share Price Volatility
articles.mainIdea: Is Lyft (LYFT) Pricing Reflect Its DCF Upside After Recent Share Price Volatility
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Is Lyft (LYFT) Pricing Reflect Its DCF Upside After Recent Share Price Volatility. If you are wondering whether Lyft's current share price reflects its true worth, you are not alone. This article will focus squarely on what the numbers say about value. Lyft shares recently closed at US$18.33, with returns of 36.7% over 1 year but a 7.4% decline year to date, which may have shifted how investors think about both upside and risk. Recent headlines have focused on Lyft's position in US ride hailing and its competition with other major platforms, as well as ongoing discussion...
